steps.body: A handful of facts resist every pattern: 6×7, 6×8, 7×8, 7×9, 8×9.
steps.narration: A handful of facts resist every pattern: 6×7, 6×8, 7×8, 7×9, 8×9.

widget.prompt: Build an array with 7 rows of 8.
widget.factorFeedback: That rectangle covers 56 squares, but not as 7 rows of 8. Build the arrangement the fact describes.
widget.successFeedback: 7 rows of 8 is 56 — the fact worth knowing on sight.
widget.lowFeedback: That is fewer than 56 squares. Keep building until the array is complete.
widget.highFeedback: That is more than 56 squares. The array should stop at 7 rows of 8.

predict.prompt: Why are facts like 7 × 8 harder than 5 × 8?
predict.reveal: ×5 and ×10 have digit patterns; ×6 through ×8 do not (×9 has its own digit pattern), so these need direct recall or a derived step.
